identification: 'Charles Horner of Halifax: A celebration of his life and work' by Tom J Lawson, hardback with dust jacket, c.2010 small specialist run. Single printing as far as known, so no first versus later printing split. Niche collector reference on Horner silver thimbles and hatpins, out of print. Under the book rule it is only worth pursuing if specialist sales show real money; the scan note guide of $30-80 is unverified and low.
